spans.text: box-and-box
The governance kernel for agent actions. It is
ring 0
: every proposed action passes through its bridge before it runs, and it returns a
certificate
— a reason — not a boolean.
It ships as a zero-dependency npm package, version
, and runs deterministically with no model and no network.
We don’t replace your policy engine. We contain it.
The bridge
Almost every agent stack computes desirability first and treats safety as a filter
afterward — it asks
best?
before
permitted?
. The bridge runs the
order a kernel must:
feasible ▸ permitted ▸ best
A vetoed option doesn’t get penalized; it is
annihilated
. Because 0̲ × anything = 0̲, no utility, however large, can outrank a forbidden action.
This single algebraic law is what makes governance composable and un-relaxable.
It is the property the conformance suite checks most heavily — see
the laws
The eight rungs
The kernel decomposes governance the way an OS decomposes the machine. Each rung is a
small algebra owning exactly one question; the bridge composes them in a precedence
that can’t be reordered at runtime.
alethic — can it happen? (feasibility floor; below it, 0̲)
deontic — is it allowed? (obligations, prohibitions, contrary-to-duty repair)
axiological — which is best? (a semiring, so preferences never resurrect a veto)
temporal — safe over time? (safety as a trajectory shield; liveness as a horizon duty)
resource — can we afford it? (a closed, double-entry economy that even prices deliberation)
epistemic — do we know enough? (a known-unknown routes to deliberation, not a guess)
strategic — who can ensure it? (coalition ability; ought-implies-can, enforced)
reflexive — may the rules change? (self-amendment that can never weaken the entrenched core)
Install

blocks.text:
npm i -g box-and-box

# run the full conformance suite in your terminal
box-and-box laws            # the 103-law core harness
box-and-box compose-laws    # the 13-law CC2 compose harness

spans.text: The verdict surface
Feed a decision spec on stdin; get a certificate on stdout. The documented exit codes
turn the kernel into a CI gate:
a decision was made,
no admissible option,
escalation required.
The utility-99 action is forbidden, so it’s annihilated;
restart_service
wins at utility 7. Conditions are data — nothing is ever
eval
